title: Apple HomeView available today
summary: Customers can now purchase Apple HomeView and experience a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage their home.
body_markdown:
## Media


-


Text of this article


November 13, 2026


UPDATE


Apple HomeView available today


Beginning today, November 13, Apple HomeView is available for purchase at Apple Store locations, on the Apple Store online, and in the Apple Store app in select regions.1 Apple HomeView gives customers a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage their home, all powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI.


Featuring a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display along with Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable and conversational, Apple HomeView is designed to be the center of the home and personal to everyone in it.2 It brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all with privacy and security built in.3


HomeView recognizes up to six people by face and adapts to show their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. And with Siri AI’s broad world knowledge, users can ask about virtually any topic and get a detailed answer. Siri AI also has onscreen awareness, so it can answer questions or take actions based on the content on the user’s screen. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI can draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more personalized responses. And it can take action across apps to help get things done.


With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant. Even when the whole household shares HomeView, personal content stays private to each person, appearing only when a user is recognized by face and their paired iPhone or iPad is present and recently unlocked.4


Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Both models work seamlessly with the Home app to manage settings, automations, and smart home accessories. The tabletop model is available in four beautiful colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray. The wall-mounted model is available in two: silver and space gray.


**Pricing and Availability**


- Customers in *Australia* , *Canada* , *India* , *New Zealand* , *Singapore* , the *UK* , and the *U.S.* can order Apple HomeView in silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray for **$299** (U.S.), and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) in space gray and silver for **$299** (U.S.), starting today from[apple.com/store](https://www.apple.com/store/) and in the Apple Store app. Apple HomeView is not available for sale in the European Union, as Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. Apple is working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.


- HomeView (Wall Mounted) is available with a choice of three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home. Power Mount USB-C Wall Connector, available starting at **$59.95** (U.S.), and Power Mount AC Wired, available starting at **$79.95** (U.S.), can be ordered today from[apple.com/store](https://www.apple.com/store/) and in the Apple Store app. Power Mount PoE Wired will be available starting in early 2027 for **$129.95** (U.S.).


- Siri AI on HomeView is available in English in the *U.S.* , *Australia* , *Canada* , *India* , *New Zealand* , *Singapore* , *South Africa* , and the *UK* .


- Canadian French-language support will be offered later via a free software update.


1. Available in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the U.S.
2. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Some devices may not be available in all regions. Siri AI is available in beta in HomeView software version 27.2. Personal context requests require a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad running the latest software version with Siri AI turned on and set to a supported language. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to Apple Intelligence terms and conditions. Learn more at[support.apple.com/148587](https://support.apple.com/148587?cid=general-apple-intelligence-b3d8fc66-62028280) .
3. Apple HomeView setup and multiuser support require a compatible iPhone or iPad running the latest software.
4. When a paired device is disconnected from Wi-Fi, personal information may remain accessible provided the user is recognized by their face, and the device was recently on the same Wi-Fi network, has an active cellular connection, is in the same location, and has been recently unlocked.
